blocks.text: 🪝 India Q4 FY26 Current Account Surplus Touches .1 Billion (0.7% of GDP). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Full-year FY26 Current Account Deficit narrows to .2 billion (0.6% of GDP).
Q4 Surplus: Current account recorded .1 billion surplus (0.7% GDP) in Jan-March Q4 FY26.
Full-Year CAD: FY26 CAD stood at .2 billion (0.6% GDP), down from .9B.
Net Inflows & Forex: Net FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) inflows .9 billion in FY26; forex reserves rose .2 billion in Q4.
Q4 surplus (.1B / 0.7% GDP) vs full-year CAD (.2B / 0.6% GDP).
